title: BEA is Launching the Survey of New Foreign Direct Investment (BE-13)!
关键词: Survey of New Foreign Direct Investment
主要内容: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) launched the Survey of New Foreign Direct Investment (BE-13) on November 21, 2014. The survey collects data on new investments made by foreign investors establishing, acquiring, or expanding U.S. businesses. This data will help assess the impact of foreign direct investment on the U.S. economy, advise foreign investors, and support national and state policies to attract such investments. Entities subject to BE-13 reporting requirements must respond, regardless of whether they are contacted by BEA.
